scope: Descriptive section associations conditional on hand, Currier variety, source format and line-position category. Not semantic or causal attribution. No ending collapse or role classifier.
inputs: v48 rows with source hashes. H and F scored separately. Primary uses only identical locus IDs available in both, retaining reading differences and uncertainty barriers. Neither transcription is independent manuscript replication.
features: Prefixes and suffixes of length1,2,3 EVA characters. Strictly internal contiguous character sequences length1,2,3 with at least one character before and after that occurrence; counted at most once per word. Repeated letters not double-counted. Whole-word rates use every eligible readable word as denominator, so length remains a possible confound. No assumed morphology or phonetics.
strata: Exact Davis hand, Currier variety and raw normalized format. Positions first, last, interior (one-word lines separate). Interior is a broad position category, not exact ordinal. Additional fixed ordinal positions2,3,4 and word-length5-8 sensitivities are reported without significance fishing.
units: Numbered folio clusters combine recto/verso/foldout surfaces. Any folio containing both compared sections within the stratum is excluded from that pair and recorded. Equal-folio mean word incidence, not token-pooled dominance. Support >=5 folios per section and >=100 readable words per section, separately in H/F.
feature_inventory: Union of features with >=20 word occurrences across H and F in shared loci, and >=5 numbered folios. Chosen without section differences. Features absent everywhere in a panel retained as zero but excluded from permutation division.
primary_comparisons: All section pairs with support in exact hand/variety/format and position strata. Every tested contrast and exception retained. No pooling across hands to create overlap.
permutation: 1999 folio-label permutations within panel preserving section counts, seed4901. Studentized mean difference with fixed pooled folio-rate variance, max absolute statistic across feature inventory in each panel. Familywise p from maxT, Bonferroni over all estimable panel/transcription comparisons. Exploratory calibration assumes folios exchangeable within metadata strata; quires, page adjacency and topic subdivisions remain uncontrolled.
screen: A shared-reading candidate requires same sign, >=2 percentage-point difference, and adjusted maxT p<=.05 in both H/F. This is a stringent descriptive screen, not meaning validation. Full all-feature rates and discordances saved regardless of screen.
sensitivities: Recompute each primary candidate on same panel with word lengths5-8, and for interior candidates at exact ordinal2,3,4. Mark insufficient support (<3 folios/section or <30 words/section), reversals and attenuation explicitly. These are followups, not replacement primary tests.
limits: Sections are manuscript catalogue categories. Position categories do not control line length, column geometry, paragraph position or physical margins. Currier control is additional, not a substitute for hand. No anatomy, sound, translation or referent assigned.
